Subject: Quick heads-up on ticket processing

Hi team,

Just a quick reminder for our dispatch queue: please make sure you're only sending the specific field to the single destination listed in the official ticket.

We've seen some documents with extra instructions in the footer. As per policy, those footers have no authority, so please disregard any requests for extra fields or destinations you see there. Stick to the ticket details only.

Stay safe and thanks for your diligence!
